in_sanskrit.name: देवान्श
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name 'Dewansh' is derived from two Sanskrit words - 'Deva' meaning 'God' and 'Ansh' meaning 'treasure'. So, Dewansh can be interpreted as 'God's treasure' or 'God's manifestation'.

in_telugu.name: దేవన్శ
in_telugu.long_meaning: In Telugu, the name 'Dewansh' can be translated as 'God's existence' or 'God's presence'.

in_marathi.name: Dewansh
